ALTERNATIVE_FAMILY_METHOD.evidence: AVERAGE_LINKAGE, COMPLETE_LINKAGE and BOUNDED_PAM are informative comparators; BOUNDED_PAM has materially higher residual rate 0.5567215015 versus 0.2052347438 for the other aggregate method surfaces, and no alternative is established as primary.

C2E_EPISODE_UNIT.evidence: C2E_CAUSAL_ADAPTER was NOT_EXECUTED_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; DIRECTIONAL_CHANGE was unavailable because the price path was not bound; PELT was capacity-unresolved at T0; only RUN_CHANGE_SEGMENTATION plus NULL_BOUNDARY_CONTROL executed.

DISTANCE_MODEL.evidence: Only GOWER_MIXED executed on the admitted real-source representation surface. L1_TYPED and L2_TYPED had no comparative real-source execution and DTW_SEQUENCE was dependency-unavailable.

FAMILY_STRUCTURE.evidence: 1619 of 1620 non-null configurations produced family evidence, but cross-method/sensitivity survival is 249507/475686 = 0.5245203769, method disagreement is 38461 records across 30/36 domains, and only one invariant core is unanimous across all 54 configurations of its domain.

GREEDY_MEDOID_STAR.evidence: The greedy lexicographic-medoid star method executed reproducibly as the preregistered baseline comparator, but benchmark evidence does not establish primary scientific authority and substantial cross-method disagreement remains.

INVARIANT_CORE.evidence: 298 invariant cores occur across 30/36 domains; 6 domains have no invariant core and only one core is unanimous 54/54. The unanimous exemplar has 20 members and minimum catalogue support 2.

LONG_HORIZON_DISCOVERY_READINESS.evidence: June computational feasibility is credible, but representation, C2E episode, distance and sensitivity/method coverage remain unresolved and June chronology is not independent long-horizon stability evidence.

REPRESENTATION.evidence: R1, five R6 ablations, R8 and R9 executed; R2 C2E_AGGREGATE, R3 ORDERED_TRANSITIONS, R4 NORMALIZED_PATH, R5 HYBRID and R7 CONTEXT_VARIANTS were dependency-unavailable. The benchmark therefore cannot freeze a comprehensive production representation shortlist.

SENSITIVITY_AND_HIERARCHY.evidence: Adjacent-sensitivity and split/merge/containment evidence exists, but cross-method/sensitivity survival is 0.5245203769 and upstream representation/distance coverage is incomplete; a production bound is not established.

UPPER_LAYER_CONFORMANCE_PROGRAMME.evidence: Method-neutral upper layers remain lawful, but representation, C2E episode, distance and sensitivity choices are not frozen enough to justify a selected-method conformance programme.
